شِيمَةٌ Nature; natural, native, or innate, disposition, temper, or other quality or property; (S, Msb, K;) as also شِئْمَةٌ, (K,) which is an extr. dial. var.: (TA:) pl. شِيَمٌ. (Msb.) ＝
-A2- Also Dust, or earth, dug from the ground; (As, S, K;) and so ↓ شِيَامٌ . (S, as on the authority of As; but only in one of my two copies of the S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
